entries.en: I'm exhausted...
It feels like my consciousness is[n]about to fade away...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Hey, are you all right?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Don't fall asleep until we reach our[n]destination.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Are you listening?
Could this be the effect of the[n]drug wearing off?
The memories I thought were gone[n]are starting to come back...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Are you listening?
I am.
What were we talking about?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You weren't paying attention? Well, I[n]guess I can see how you'd be lost in[n]thought right now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, we need to talk about how to[n]get out of this situation.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba's monitoring of Akechi's phone[n]has confirmed it... He did indeed have[n]an ulterior motive.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's on a completely different level[n]than just that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Not only was he trying to frame us, but[n]he was the true culprit behind the mental[n]shutdowns...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: His offer to assist us was simply a ploy to[n]frame the Phantom Thieves... and kill[n][fName].

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we go into Sis's Palace as he suggests,[n]we'll likely be met by a large ambush of[n]police forces.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think he would be this far gone...[n]I know now what it means to feel a chill[n]down my spine.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Furthermore, he wishes to bring a police[n]squad from reality into the Palace...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If the eight of us can enter at once, it's[n]not inconceivable to think a larger[n]group is possible.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He may even be able to bring in vehicles[n]or other special pieces of equipment.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So this really was just a setup to shift[n]the blame onto us...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He made us go after Okumura, then[n]once we triggered the change of heart,[n]he killed him...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And he told us he had seen the true[n]culprit... but it was him the entire time!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The whole time he was workin' with[n]Makoto's sister, he was really just some[n]homicidal maniac!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, we gotta take that bastard[n]Akechi down! Isn't that recording[n]we got enough proof to do it!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No, Akechi is merely a tool. His orders[n]come from elsewhere... The grand[n]mastermind behind this all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: An unimaginable fiend capable of[n]arranging the murder of a suspect[n]inside of a police station...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Unless we find out who that is, we will[n]continue being targeted even if we defeat[n]Akechi...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But... what means do we have of learning[n]his identity?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We'll have to make Akechi say it... though[n]once we do, that mastermind will likely[n]eliminate us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think that will be the case eventually[n]regardless of whether or not we learn[n]his identity.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The only reason it hasn't happened yet[n]is because we're an easy target to blame[n]for his crimes.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If he realizes that's no longer possible[n]and abandons that plan, he may opt to[n]kill us immediately.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit... So we don't got a choice but[n]to go with that bastard's suggestion...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But if we go into the Palace like we're told,[n][fName] will get arrested and then[n]Akechi will kill him...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Palace...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Palace...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Actually, there's something I'd like to[n]say regarding—

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Aha! We can use the Palace to our[n]advantage!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What's this all of a sudden!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's a way...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A way to get past Akechi AND get the[n]mastermind to lay off of us, all while[n]learning his identity.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Really!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You gotta be kidding me!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If he wants to kill [fName], why not[n]let him?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That is, inside of a Palace...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. We could have him kill the[n]cognitive [fName], all the while[n]believing he killed the real one.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, that's it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems that's our only option.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Listen close, everyone. I have a plan for[n]how we can carry this operation out...
